issue_context.title: OneDrive backup location requires re-authentication after reboot
issue_context.body:
### The problem

After rebooting my host (HAOS 14.2) and attempting a backup were OneDrive is (one of the) target location, that backup fails and repairs are being made: Authentication expired for OneDrive.

After re-authentication the OneDrive backup works again.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2025.2.0b9

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2025.2.0b7 

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

backup

### Link to integration documentation on our website

_No response_

### Diagnostics information

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b693c831-e4e9-43b9-9b79-0bc958653286)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8a9ac1c7-74d1-4085-a21b-ddbf782084f4)



### Example YAML snippet

```yaml

```

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

